vectors.description: subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 1, whose object carries Prior Group ID Gap 2 (Extension Header Type 0x40). Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." The gap is larger than the Group ID, so the track is malformed, which an endpoint detects from this Object alone
vectors.error_detail: Prior Group ID Gap 2 is larger than Group ID 1

vectors.description: subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 5, with two objects carrying Prior Group ID Gap 2 and 3 (Extension Header Type 0x40). Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." The values differ within one Group, so the track is malformed
vectors.error_detail: the Objects in Group 5 carry no Prior Group ID Gap value in common

vectors.description: subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 5, whose object carries Prior Group ID Gap 2 and 3 (Extension Header Type 0x40 twice). Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." This draft does not say whether an Object may carry 0x40 more than once, or which value is that Object's when it does (Section 9.1.1.2: "Object Extension Headers are serialized as Key-Value-Pairs"). The condition needs more than one Object, so the values one Object carries are not compared with each other, and the track is not malformed

subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 5, with two objects: the first carries Prior Group ID Gap 2 and 3, the second 2. Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." This draft does not say whether an Object may carry 0x40 more than once, or which value is that Object's when it does (Section 9.1.1.2: "Object Extension Headers are serialized as Key-Value-Pairs"). Taking 2 as each Object's makes them equal and another reading makes them differ, so whether the track is malformed is ambiguous; only Objects with no value in common differ under every reading, and the decoder does not refuse this

subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 5, with two objects: the first carries Prior Group ID Gap 2 and 3, the second 4. Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." Whichever of its values is taken as the first Object's, it differs from the second's, so the track is malformed
vectors.error_detail: the Objects in Group 5 carry no Prior Group ID Gap value in common

vectors.description: subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 5, whose object carries Prior Group ID Gap 2 and then 6 (Extension Header Type 0x40 twice). Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." This draft does not say whether an Object may carry 0x40 more than once, or which value is that Object's when it does (Section 9.1.1.2: "Object Extension Headers are serialized as Key-Value-Pairs"). Taking 6 as the Object's makes its gap larger than the Group ID and taking 2 does not, so whether the track is malformed is ambiguous; only an Object whose every value is larger than the Group ID has a gap larger than it under every reading, and the decoder does not refuse this

This draft does not say whether an Object may carry 0x40 more than once, or which value is that Object's when it does (Section 9.1.1.2: "Object Extension Headers are serialized as Key-Value-Pairs"). Taking 3 as each Object's makes them equal and another reading makes them differ, so whether the track is malformed is ambiguous; only Objects with no value in common differ under every reading, and the decoder does not refuse this

subgroup stream (type 0x09: extensions present), Group 5, with three objects: the first carries Prior Group ID Gap 1 and 2, the second 2 and 3, the third 1 and 3. Section 10.1: "A track with a Group that contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap or has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID is considered malformed." Each two of the objects share a value, but no value is carried by all three: whichever of its values is taken as each Object's, two of them differ, so the track is malformed
